"""Serialization CPU diagnostic; excludes writes and is not a storage gate."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,time
from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--source',required=True);parser.add_argument('--output',required=True)
args=parser.parse_args();sys.path.insert(0,args.source)
from commontrace.hierarchical import AtomicFact
source=Path(args.source)/'commontrace/hierarchical.py'
report={'scope':__doc__,'source_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=args.source,text=True).strip(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'python':sys.version,'results':[]}
for label,origin,count in [('scalar',{'author':'human'},50000),('nested',{'details':{'quotes':['alpha','beta']}},5000)]:
 fact=AtomicFact('sample','Component uses durable event storage','general',['a'],.8,1,'2026-01-01',None,origin=origin)
 expected=asdict(fact)
 for _ in range(3):
  started=time.perf_counter()
  for n in range(count):actual=fact.to_dict()
  elapsed=time.perf_counter()-started
  assert actual==expected
  report['results'].append({'case':label,'calls':count,'seconds':elapsed,'calls_per_second':count/elapsed})
report['runner_source']=Path(__file__).read_text()
Path(args.output).write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['results']))
